<div style="width:90%;margin:0 auto;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#E0DBE5 0.6px,transparent 0.6px);background-size:18px 18px;padding:1.35em 1.1em;border-radius:18px;font-size:1.12em;">

 <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:0.9em;align-items:stretch;">

  <!-- /compact -->
  <div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid rgba(44,62,80,0.2);border-radius:14px;padding:1.05em 1.1em 1.15em;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(44,62,80,0.12);text-align:left;display:flex;flex-direction:column;">

   <div style="font-size:0.62em;font-weight:800;color:#2C3E50;line-height:1.2;">Continue the task</div>
   <div style="height:1px;background:rgba(44,62,80,0.16);margin:0.75em 0 0;"></div>

   <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.6em;margin-top:0.85em;">
    <div style="width:2em;height:2em;border-radius:0.5em;background:#E8ECF0;border:1px solid #C5CED8;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#2C3E50;flex-shrink:0;"><i data-lucide="fold-vertical" style="width:1.05em;height:1.05em;stroke-width:1.8;"></i></div>
    <div style="font-family:'Maple Mono',monospace;font-size:0.68em;font-weight:700;color:#2C3E50;">/compact</div>
   </div>

   <!-- before -> after, same starting fill in both cards so they compare -->
   <div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0.6em;margin-top:1em;">
    <div style="flex:1;">
     <div style="height:0.68em;border-radius:999px;background:#EDEAF2;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:78%;height:100%;background:#B9B4C6;"></div></div>
     <div style="font-family:'Maple Mono',monospace;font-size:0.4em;color:#9B8EA0;margin-top:0.45em;">78%</div>
    </div>
    <div style="height:0.68em;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0;"><i data-lucide="arrow-right" style="width:0.75em;height:0.75em;stroke-width:2.2;color:#9B8EA0;"></i></div>
    <div style="flex:1;">
     <div style="height:0.68em;border-radius:999px;background:#EDEAF2;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:18%;height:100%;background:#2C3E50;"></div></div>
     <div style="font-family:'Maple Mono',monospace;font-size:0.4em;color:#2C3E50;font-weight:700;margin-top:0.45em;">18%</div>
    </div>
   </div>

   <div style="font-size:0.54em;color:#564232;line-height:1.4;margin-top:0.95em;">History becomes a short summary.</div>

  </div>

  <div style="align-self:center;font-family:'Maple Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6em;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.06em;color:#5654A2;">VS</div>

  <!-- /clear -->
  <div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid rgba(212,95,71,0.22);border-radius:14px;padding:1.05em 1.1em 1.15em;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(212,95,71,0.14);text-align:left;display:flex;flex-direction:column;">

   <div style="font-size:0.62em;font-weight:800;color:#D45F47;line-height:1.2;">Start a new task</div>
   <div style="height:1px;background:rgba(212,95,71,0.2);margin:0.75em 0 0;"></div>

   <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.6em;margin-top:0.85em;">
    <div style="width:2em;height:2em;border-radius:0.5em;background:#FCEEEC;border:1px solid #F0C5BA;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#D45F47;flex-shrink:0;"><i data-lucide="eraser" style="width:1.05em;height:1.05em;stroke-width:1.8;"></i></div>
    <div style="font-family:'Maple Mono',monospace;font-size:0.68em;font-weight:700;color:#D45F47;">/clear</div>
   </div>

   <div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0.6em;margin-top:1em;">
    <div style="flex:1;">
     <div style="height:0.68em;border-radius:999px;background:#EDEAF2;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:78%;height:100%;background:#B9B4C6;"></div></div>
     <div style="font-family:'Maple Mono',monospace;font-size:0.4em;color:#9B8EA0;margin-top:0.45em;">78%</div>
    </div>
    <div style="height:0.68em;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0;"><i data-lucide="arrow-right" style="width:0.75em;height:0.75em;stroke-width:2.2;color:#9B8EA0;"></i></div>
    <div style="flex:1;">

     <div style="font-family:'Maple Mono',monospace;font-size:0.4em;color:#D45F47;font-weight:700;margin-top:0.45em;">0%</div>
    </div>
   </div>

   <div style="font-size:0.54em;color:#564232;line-height:1.4;margin-top:0.95em;">A brand new session.</div>

  </div>

 </div>

 <div style="height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#C4C3E8,transparent);margin:1.3em 0 0;"></div>

 <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.55em;margin-top:0.95em;font-size:0.54em;color:#2C3E50;line-height:1.4;text-align:left;">
  <i data-lucide="sparkles" style="width:1.1em;height:1.1em;stroke-width:2;color:#5654A2;flex-shrink:0;"></i>
  <span>Save your <span style="color:#C4881A;font-weight:700;">tokens</span> while retaining your agentic workflow <span style="color:#5654A2;font-weight:700;">quality</span>.</span>
 </div>

</div>
